rules.jsonl.scheme_version: date-versioned rule file this rule came from
rules.jsonl.when: machine-readable condition tree over typed profile fields (leaf: field/op/value; combinators: any/all)
rules.jsonl.clause: verbatim or tightly-quoted official scheme text this rule encodes
rules.jsonl.source_url: exact government source the clause was read from
rules.jsonl.ask: plain-language question that resolves the fact when unknown
rules.jsonl.self_declared: true if the state verifies this fact (softens 'eligible' to 'likely_eligible')

schemes.jsonl.name: full scheme name
schemes.jsonl.simplifications: honest omissions — criteria in the official text not yet encoded

personas.jsonl.message: free-text household description, as a user would phrase it
